About this opportunity

Waitlist affordable housing opportunity at 270 Pulaski Street in Brooklyn. Source: St. Nicks Alliance. See the official source for complete descriptions, photographs, floor plans, eligibility details, and application instructions.

Application instructions

Submit only one application per household by regular mail. The official form accepts Studio, 1BR, 2BR, 3BR, and 4BR requests. Do not use mail that requires a signature. Mail to 270 Pulaski Street, LP, c/o St. Nicks Alliance, 260 Powers Street, Brooklyn, NY 11211.
